notes.title: Version 1.3.0 Update Information
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40995878/9784f4e7739ca77781ad60da798ab3c89b3a5588.jpg

Hello from Waku Waku Games.

As at 9-Dec 2022, we've released an update to The Hundred Year Kingdom that fixes bugs and adjusts the balance of the game. We apologize for the inconvenience, but would appreciate it if you installed the update.

The changes and fixes made in this update are as follows:

[Version 1.3.0 Patch note]

Addition of two new worlds

A world of fire and ice.
New terrain, volcanoes and ice, and tundra have been added to this world.
Make full use of the newly added terrain to develop your civilization.

A World Without an Oracle
This is a world where the blessings of the oracle priestess are no longer available.
Your skills as a creator will be put to the test.


Bug fixes:
/ Fixed a bug in which some buttons could be pressed while the menu was open.
/ Fixed a bug that the game can be resumed when returning to the title in the fantasy world.

Upon applying this update, the game version will be "1.3.0".
Thanks for playing, and for your cooperation.

notes.title: Update Information (28-June)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40995878/9784f4e7739ca77781ad60da798ab3c89b3a5588.jpg

Hi, everybody! This is Waku Waku Games.

An update with a new world was released on June 28, 2022.
Please take a few minutes to apply the update.

The following items have been updated:

A new "World of Agriculture" full of food has been added.
Welcome to the world of marble and iron, "The World of Mines" has been added.

As the name suggests, each world is biased toward either food or production.

In "World of Agriculture," even novice players can create a successful civilization with relative ease, while in "World of Mines," food availability is limited and requires a thorough knowledge of the game rules and strategy. For those creators who are skilled, we encourage you to take on this challenge.

We hope you continue to enjoy "The Hundred Year Kingdom".
And, We look forward to hearing your comments and suggestions!

Cheers,
Waku Waku Games and Kaeru-san games.

notes.title: Update Information (19-Mar 2022)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40995878/9784f4e7739ca77781ad60da798ab3c89b3a5588.jpg

Hello from Waku Waku Games.

We've released an update to The Hundred Year Kingdom that fixes bugs and adjusts the balance of the game. We apologize for the inconvenience, but would appreciate it if you installed the update.

The changes and fixes made in this update are as follows:

・Fixed bug that sometimes showed multiple offerings when cursor was moved over it repeatedly.

・Fixed bug that showed incorrect available building options after switching language.

・Fixed bug that prevented main cursor from moving when controller is connected.

・Altered program to make transition to title smoother on startup.

・Changed requirements for Petra (Inanna's unique heritage) from "Civilization + Number of Heritage x 10" to "Civilization + Heritage Level x 25".

・ Changed version notation to latest version.

notes.title: Trial Version released at Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
The Hundred Year Kingdom will be participating in the Steam Next Fest starting October 1, 2021 (Pacific Standard Time)! The trial version lets you develop a world over 20 years. Don't miss the chance to experience an early taste of all the game has to offer.
Add The Hundred Year Kingdom to your wishlist today!


Build legendary civilizations with the help of goddesses.
The Hundred Year Kingdom, the turn-based simulation game that makes it easy to develop and nurture civilizations, is coming to Steam this winter. Together with a goddess of your choice, turn a pristine wilderness into a magnificent civilization within 100 years (100 turns). Challenge yourself by establishing a vast range of buildings and structures to improve your world's food production, resource utilization, and culture within the time limit to foster a peerless civilization that's all yours!
